name: Evidence Transition Baseline
description: Every governed transition of a Evidence passes through the Transition Engine, which records the transition, its actor and its authority badge.

conditions.statement: Every transition of a Evidence governed by this Policy is applied by the Transition Engine with a recorded actor and authority badge.

requiredEvidence.title: Evidence Transition Record
requiredEvidence.description: The transition record written by the Transition Engine when the Evidence transition is applied.
